content.value_statement: Generic UI output can make products feel unfinished and forgettable. This skill guides AI agents to create distinctive, responsive interfaces with stronger typography, color, layout, and motion.
actual_capabilities: Guides selection of a clear aesthetic direction before implementation.
Covers typography, color, motion, layout, backgrounds, and visual details.
Supports React, Vue, and native HTML/CSS interface requests.
Provides examples for landing pages, dashboards, and reusable components.
Defines quality checks for semantic HTML, responsive design, accessibility, and performance.
limitations: It is guidance, not a reusable component library.
It does not validate final code in a browser by itself.
It may suggest external design resources that need policy review.
Brand, copy, and accessibility requirements still need project-specific checks.

use_cases.title: Launch a Product Page
use_cases.description: Create a distinctive landing page with strong hierarchy, memorable visual details, and responsive sections.

use_cases.title: Build Internal Dashboards
use_cases.description: Turn dense metrics into a polished dashboard with clear layouts, states, and data-first styling.

use_cases.title: Upgrade Component Styling
use_cases.description: Redesign buttons, cards, and UI modules with consistent tokens, interactions, and accessibility basics.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Landing Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new marketing page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a responsive landing page for [product]. Choose a clear aesthetic direction and implement the page in [framework].

prompt_templates.title: Refine Existing UI
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate redesign of an existing screen.
prompt_templates.prompt: Redesign this [component or page] for [audience]. Keep the existing functionality and improve hierarchy, typography, color, and responsive behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Build Dashboard Experience
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced interface with dense information and states.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a data dashboard for [domain]. Include layout, visual style, interaction states, accessibility considerations, and production-ready implementation details.

prompt_templates.title: Define Design Language
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a full frontend design direction for [product]. Specify typography, color tokens, component patterns, motion rules, responsive strategy, and quality checks.

output_examples.input: Create a landing page for a developer analytics product.
output_examples.output: A responsive landing page concept with an asymmetrical hero, technical typography, high-contrast calls to action, and accessible mobile sections.

output_examples.input: Redesign a data dashboard for finance teams.
output_examples.output: A dense dashboard direction with clear metric hierarchy, restrained motion, dark and light state guidance, and data-first card layouts.

output_examples.input: Create a reusable button system for a React app.
output_examples.output: A component direction with primary, secondary, text, loading, disabled, and size variants, plus interaction and accessibility guidance.

best_practices: Start with the audience, task, and aesthetic direction before choosing colors or layout.
Use semantic structure, responsive constraints, and accessibility checks in every implementation.
Vary typography, color, and composition across projects to avoid generic output.
anti_patterns: Using default fonts, centered card grids, and purple gradients without product context.
Adding motion to every element without respecting reduced-motion preferences.
Treating visual polish as separate from maintainable HTML, CSS, and component structure.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create frontend pages, components, dashboards, landing pages, and visual materials with stronger design direction.

faq.question: Does it write production code?
faq.answer: It guides the agent to produce practical code, but final testing remains the developer responsibility.

faq.question: Which frameworks are covered?
faq.answer: It references React, Vue, and native HTML/CSS, with room for project-specific tools.

faq.question: Can it improve an existing interface?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide redesigns while preserving current functionality and improving hierarchy, spacing, typography, and motion.

faq.question: Does it replace a brand system?
faq.answer: No. It can create a direction, but approved brand tokens and accessibility standards should still be applied.

faq.question: Is the skill safe to use?
faq.answer: The audit found no executable code in the skill file. Review generated frontend output before deployment.
